arguments.description: Full tool arguments, including a command or the proposed file changes.

ContextResponse.description: Read-only estimate of the currently loaded context, using the compaction heuristic.

oneOf.description: Session-only usage; never belongs to the active conversation turn.
Session-only usage; never belongs to the active conversation turn.

EventsParams.description: GET /v1/events?session={id}&after={seq}. Zero requests the complete history.

EventsResponse.description: One SSE data frame, encoded as the event itself (not a JSON array).

InfoResponse.description: GET /v1/info. Each session carries its own replay cursor; there is no global sequence.

ModelListResponse.description: GET /v1/models. The configured catalog is returned in full.

eventSeq.description: The original resolution's sequence when alreadyResolved is true.

SessionBtwParams.description: An ephemeral question. Its response stream is private to this HTTP caller.

SessionCompactResponse.description: Accepted compaction; completion is reported by the referenced turn's events.

SessionCreateParams.description: POST /v1/sessions. Do not log this body: env may contain credentials.

SessionHandoffParams.description: Generate a private handoff note from an idle session's current context.

SessionInputParams.description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/input. Idle starts a turn; mode applies when busy.

review.description: Present for a read-only review turn; the single-line display title.

turnId.description: None while queued for a future turn.

SessionInterruptParams.description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/interrupt, with the target turn as a precondition.

SessionListResponse.description: GET /v1/sessions. Each summary carries its own lastEventSeq.

SessionResumeParams.description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/resume. Never log this body or replace an open session's environment.

SessionSettings.description: Public settings. Environment variables never belong here.

closeReason.description: Why the session is closed; absent for open sessions and legacy data.

createdAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds; zero until the first event is applied.

SessionUpdateParams.description:
PATCH /v1/sessions/{id}. Omitted/null fields retain their current values.
The resulting complete public settings are emitted in session.updated.

SkillListResponse.description: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/skills. Frozen when the session is opened.

contextTokens.description: Current context occupancy, distinct from cumulative billed input tokens.

request.description: Absent in old events; present with a null cost for an unpriced request.
